purpose: Investigate native-prefix divergence after exact observable reset matching; no success-rate claims
conditions: same1: fresh constructor, normal native inputs
same2: same environment, restore identical anchor
same_png: same environment, restore anchor, serialize current camera PNGs and wait two seconds once
fresh1: recreate the environment, restore identical anchor
fresh2: recreate the environment again, restore identical anchor
observations: Exact parent XML, integration-state, RNG, image/state and instruction fingerprint before each partial episode
Two consecutive native forwards with identical data and noise seed at every query
Per-query input, camera, state and action fingerprints
All predicted actions, policy states and MuJoCo integration states after every control
Small numeric robot/controller/buffer state before execution and every action chunk
comparison_policy: Keep all failures and reset mismatches. No relaxation of the parent fingerprint. Compare same-environment replay, PNG/wall-time handling and fresh constructors separately. Diagnostic episodes are not counted as completed policy failures.
